macro.headline: Geopolitical tensions escalate energy costs, 'Higher for Longer' rates squeeze discretionary spending and growth sectors.
themes: Escalating US-Iran tensions and potential disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz are driving a significant geopolitical risk premium on global oil and LNG prices.

Major central banks, including the RBA and Fed, are reiterating a 'higher for longer' interest rate stance due to persistent wage pressures and sticky inflation data, pushing back rate cut expectations.
Australian consumer confidence remains weak amidst high interest rates and cost of living pressures, severely impacting discretionary spending and housing affordability.
